g.text: Elasticsearch plays a crucial role in the food delivery system design,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: primarily serving as a powerful search and analytics engine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for restaurants, menu items, and related information.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Purpose of Elasticsearch in the Food Delivery System:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Fast and Efficient Searching: Elasticsearch enables quick and relevant

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: search results for users looking for restaurants, cuisines, or specific dishes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Real-time Updates: It allows for near real-time updates of restaurant

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: information, menus, and prices, ensuring customers always see the most current data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Complex Querying: Elasticsearch supports complex queries, including geospatial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: searches, which are crucial for finding nearby restaurants or determining delivery areas.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Scalability: It can handle large volumes of data and high concurrent searches, which

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is essential for a food delivery platform with millions of users and restaurants.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Faceted Search: Elasticsearch facilitates faceted search, allowing users to filter

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: results by cuisine type, price range, ratings, etc.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Fuzzy Matching: It can handle typos and provide relevant results even when search

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Elasticsearch plays a crucial role in the food delivery system design,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: primarily serving as a powerful search and analytics engine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Its purpose is to provide fast, scalable, and efficient search

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: capabilities for restaurants, menu items, and related information.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The Real-Time Tracking DB stores dynamic, unstructured data such as the GPS coordinates

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: of delivery drivers. Since driver locations change frequently, a NoSQL database is preferred

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: over traditional relational databases because it can handle high-frequency updates, offers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: flexibility with unstructured data, and is highly scalable for large datasets.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Popular NoSQL Databases in the Market:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Redis: An in-memory key-value store often used as a cache, but it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: can also manage real-time tracking if combined with geospatial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: extensions like RedisGeo, which supports storing and querying location-based data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * MongoDB: A widely-used document-based NoSQL database, offering

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: excellent support for geospatial queries, which are essential for tracking locations.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Cassandra: A highly scalable NoSQL database, optimized for write-heavy

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: workloads and capable of handling massive amounts of data. Ideal for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: real-time tracking in large systems like Uber Eats.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Firebase Realtime Database: A NoSQL cloud database offered by Google, designed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for real-time data syncing, commonly used for tracking locations in mobile applications.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * DynamoDB (AWS): [Expensive] A fully managed NoSQL database that offers high performance

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and scales automatically. Its integration with AWS services makes it a great

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: choice for large-scale real-time tracking systems.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | Transcode video | Encode different resolutions/bitrates/codecs | **FFmpeg** running on CPU/GPU workers |

g.text: “Once the original upload completes in S3, an object-created

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: event starts a durable video-processing workflow. I would use

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: something like Temporal as the DAG orchestrator.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Temporal itself doesn't process the media. It schedules work

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to different worker pools. We first inspect and logically split

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the video using FFprobe or FFmpeg. Then the expensive work

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: fans out across many FFmpeg workers, which generate multiple

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: renditions such as 360p, 720p and 1080p. Audio, thumbnails

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and transcription can run in parallel as well.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: These workers can run as containers on Kubernetes or ECS,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and the transcoding pools can scale independently based on

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: task backlog and CPU or GPU utilization.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Large intermediate files are always written to S3. The workflow

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: only passes S3 object references, not the actual media bytes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Once all required renditions complete, the workflow fans back

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: in and a packaging step generates HLS or DASH manifests

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: referencing the different segments. We store those manifests

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and segments in S3, update the video's metadata to READY,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and then serve the assets through the CDN.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The key reason for the DAG is that transcoding is CPU-intensive

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: but highly parallelizable. Temporal gives us dependency management,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: retries and durable execution, while FFmpeg does the actual media work.”

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: For tens of millions of concurrent View API requests, my main goal

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is to make sure the majority of those requests never hit the database.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: I would keep the Event Service stateless and horizontally scale many

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: In front of the database, I’d use Redis as a distributed cache. Event

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: details, performer information, venue metadata, and seat-map information

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: are very read-heavy but change infrequently, so they are excellent cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The read path becomes: client to load balancer, then Event Service, then

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Redis. On a cache hit we return immediately. On a miss, we read from the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: database, populate Redis, and return the response.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: I’d use longer TTLs for static data such as venue information and shorter

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: TTLs for more dynamic data. When event metadata changes, the application

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: publishes an invalidation event so the corresponding cache entry is removed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: For additional protection, I’d use database read replicas, cache pre-warming

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for major events, and stampede protection so millions of simultaneous cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: So the scaling strategy is essentially: stateless horizontal scaling at the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: service layer, aggressive distributed caching, and keeping the database off

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to reach the seat-selection and booking services simultaneously.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: enter a Redis-backed queue, for example a sorted set ordered by

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: of the downstream booking system. When a user is admitted, we issue

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a short-lived admission token or store their session in Redis.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This gives us controlled backpressure, protects the booking and inventory

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: systems from overload, and still gives users real-time feedback while they wait.”
